user.title: Apple TV Mgmt — device
user.description: Pick what kind of device this profile is for. Apple TV uses pyatv + AdGuard. Xbox uses FRITZ!Box presence + internet-access switch (no Microsoft account needed).

apple_tv.title: Apple TV Mgmt
apple_tv.description: Set up a parental-control profile for one Apple TV. The Apple TV integration must already be set up and producing a media_player entity.

data.adguard_username: AdGuard username (only for direct AdGuard with HTTP auth)
data.adguard_password: AdGuard password (only for direct AdGuard with HTTP auth)
data.adguard_client_name: AdGuard client name for this Apple TV

data_description.adguard_url: Optional DNS-block layer. Base address of AdGuard Home, or of the proxy add-on. Leave blank to run without AdGuard — enforcement still works via Apple-TV-sleep and TV-off.

xbox.title: Apple TV Mgmt — Xbox
xbox.description: Track an Xbox via the FRITZ!Box: presence (device_tracker) for time tracking, an internet-access switch for enforcement. No Microsoft / Xbox Live account or HACS setup needed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach AdGuard Home (check URL/port and that the addon is running). See HA log for details.
error.client_not_found: AdGuard client with that name doesn't exist.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check HA log for the traceback.
error.invalid_quiet_windows: Quiet-windows format invalid — expected comma-separated HH:MM-HH:MM[:Label].
error.client_name_required: Enter the AdGuard client name (or clear the AdGuard URL to run without AdGuard).

abort.already_configured: This Apple TV is already configured.

data.idle_grace_minutes: Idle grace: keep counting after pause (minutes)
data.tv_entity_id: TV media_player entity (optional — for hard TV shutdown)
data.tv_shutdown_enabled: Also shut down the TV when enforcement triggers
data.quiet_windows: Quiet windows (e.g. "20:30-07:00:Bedtime, 12:00-14:00:Lunch") — leave blank for none
data.adult_mode_duration_min: Adult mode duration (minutes) — how long the override switch bypasses enforcement
data.budget_tv_shows: Daily budget for TV Shows (minutes, 0 = unlimited)
data.budget_other: Daily budget for Other apps (minutes, 0 = unlimited)
data.budget_linear_tv: Daily budget for Live TV (minutes, 0 = unlimited)
data.notify_target: HA notify service for parent approval push (e.g. mobile_app_your_phone)
data.request_expire_min: Auto-deny pending extension requests after N minutes

force_block.name: Force block
force_block.description: Immediately enforce — block AdGuard and sleep the Apple TV.

grant_extension.name: Grant extension
grant_extension.description: Add (or remove) minutes from today's budget.
